keyLimits.en: Unlimited users, pay-per-signature model on top of the base subscription: 1.80 CHF per Qualified Electronic Signature (QES) and 1.00 CHF per Advanced Electronic Signature (AES)

addOns.name: Per-signature fees: 1.80 CHF/QES, 1.00 CHF/AES, billed separately from the subscription

cautions.en: The base subscription price does not include signatures: each qualified or advanced signature is billed per-unit on top of the monthly fee, which can make effective cost much higher than the headline 9 CHF/month depending on volume.

capabilities.en: Qualified Electronic Signature (QES) compliant with EU eIDAS regulation, giving signatures the same legal standing as handwritten ones.
Supports multiple signature levels (Simple, Advanced, Qualified) for different legal requirements per document.
Unlimited users included even on the entry Fair plan, with cost driven by per-signature usage instead of seats.

limitations.en: No free/permanent plan; only a 14-day trial with 20 free signatures before billing begins.
Per-signature pricing on top of the subscription makes total cost variable and harder to predict for high-volume signing needs.

reason.en: Major e-signature competitor, though without Skribble's Swiss/EU qualified signature specialization.
European e-signature provider competing directly on EU-compliant electronic signatures.
Enterprise e-signature competitor offering similar compliance-grade signing options.

unknowns: Higher pricing tiers above 'Fair' (if any) were not detailed in the seed or fetched data; only the entry plan and per-signature fees were confirmed.
